# 11. Replicate concordance — the decisive test

A permutation p-value says "more spread than chance". It cannot rule out depth
differences, ambient RNA, demuxlet misassignment, or per-strain growth-rate
differences — the shuffle destroys all of those along with genotype.

Reproducibility across an independent capture can. **If the variable genes show
higher cross-replicate correlation than background, the effect is real. If both
sit near zero, the hits are noise passing a permutation test.** This single
comparison is worth more than everything upstream of it.

To produce `obs2`: copy §1.1–§3 into a separate script with `ROOT` pointed at
YPD.2, then `obs2 <- fit_by_group(Y_cc2, tvec2, gvec2, depth = depthv2)`.
`saveRDS(obs2, ...)` so you do not refit every session.

```{r}
ggsave <- function(filename, ...) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(filename, ...)
  if (grepl("\\.png$", filename, ignore.case = TRUE))
    ggplot2::ggsave(sub("\\.png$", ".tiff", filename, ignore.case = TRUE), ...,
                    compression = "lzw")
  invisible(filename)
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

WRAP <- 88

circ_mean_rows <- function(M, period = WRAP) {
  th <- 2 * pi * M / period
  (atan2(rowMeans(sin(th), na.rm = TRUE),
         rowMeans(cos(th), na.rm = TRUE)) %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi) * period
}

circ_sd_rows <- function(M, period = WRAP) {
  th <- 2 * pi * M / period
  R  <- sqrt(rowMeans(cos(th), na.rm = TRUE)^2 + rowMeans(sin(th), na.rm = TRUE)^2)
  R  <- pmin(pmax(R, 1e-8), 1)
  sqrt(-2 * log(R)) / (2 * pi) * period
}
```

#Compute offset is a per sample "technical quality offset"/ "Computed but unused downstream"

**Not run (`eval = FALSE`): not used in the paper.**

It's a QC/normalization step producing a per-cell (or per-sample) correction factor derived only from genes whose model fit is trustworthy [mean_r2_g > 0.1 & pct_detected_g > 0.7], so downstream comparisons aren't skewed by noisy or undetected genes
```{r, eval = FALSE}
compute_offset <- function(obs) {
  mean_r2_g      <- rowMeans(obs$r2_adj, na.rm = TRUE) #mean of r2 across columns for each gene - one r2 value per gene - how well signal fits across cells
  pct_detected_g <- 1 - rowSums(obs$constant == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / ncol(obs$constant) #fraction of column where gene isn't constant meaning gene has zero variance/undetected
  well_g <- names(mean_r2_g)[mean_r2_g > 0.1 & pct_detected_g > 0.7]

  zrow <- function(M) t(scale(t(M)))
  Z <- zrow(obs$r2_adj[well_g, , drop = FALSE])
  list(well = well_g, offset = colMeans(Z, na.rm = TRUE))
}

res1    <- compute_offset(obs1)
res2    <- compute_offset(obs2)
offset  <- res1$offset
offset2 <- res2$offset

cat("YPD.1 well-measured genes used for offset:", length(res1$well), "\n")
cat("YPD.2 well-measured genes used for offset:", length(res2$well), "\n")

cat("\ncor(strain offset rep1, rep2):",
    round(cor(offset[names(offset2)], offset2,
              use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman"), 3), "\n")
```


#Compare the two datasets Jaccard overlap (a.k.a. Jaccard index/similarity) is a measure of how much two sets agree, defined as the size of their intersection divided by the size of their union:

Jaccard = |A ∩ B| / |A ∪ B|

It ranges from 0 to 1. 1 = perfect replicate; 0 no overlap
```{r}
compare_sig_lists <- function(sig1, sig2, label) {
  g1 <- sig1$gene; g2 <- sig2$gene
  both  <- intersect(g1, g2)
  only1 <- setdiff(g1, g2)
  only2 <- setdiff(g2, g1)

  cat("\n==", label, "==\n")
  cat("YPD.1 significant:", length(g1), "| YPD.2 significant:", length(g2), "\n")
  cat("Significant in BOTH:", length(both), "\n")
  cat("Only YPD.1:", length(only1), "| Only YPD.2:", length(only2), "\n")
  cat("Jaccard overlap:", round(length(both) / length(union(g1, g2)), 3), "\n")

  invisible(list(both = both, only1 = only1, only2 = only2))
}
```

#Permutation test tells us a gene's between strain-spread is bigger than expected from shuffling strain labels. But, permutation can't distinguidh genuine biological variation from technical confounds

concordance() and circ_conc() ask "does the pattern across strains reproduce in a second, independently-captured dataset (YPD.2)?"

concordabce - takes a gene's 74 strains per-strain values (R-square or amplitude) from replicate 1 and replicate 2, performs spearman correlation between them

circ_conc - does the same thing with peak timing

# The median r (this is spearman correlation r) correlation for variable genes should be higher than for genes with false variable genes (false as in non-significant ones from ypd.1). Keep in mind  conc_peak uses R i.e., circular concentration (R close to 1 is reproducible; median_abs_shift close to 0 is reproducible). Because peak_time isn't circular we are using this
```{r}
concordance <- function(M1, M2, min_strains = 20) {
  genes   <- intersect(rownames(M1), rownames(M2))
  strains <- intersect(colnames(M1), colnames(M2))
  map_dfr(genes, function(g) {
    a <- M1[g, strains]; b <- M2[g, strains]; ok <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(b)
    tibble(gene = g, n = sum(ok),
           r = if (sum(ok) >= min_strains)
                 cor(a[ok], b[ok], method = "spearman") else NA_real_)
  })
}
```

```{r}
# ── Build the long-format table for plotting ────────────────────────────────
conc_long <- bind_rows(
  # conc_r2   %>% transmute(gene, stat = "Structure (R2_adj)", value = r,
  #                          is_variable = gene %in% sig_structure_1$gene),
  conc_amp  %>% transmute(gene, stat = "Amplitude",          value = r,
                           is_variable = gene %in% sig_amplitude_1$gene)
  # conc_peak %>% transmute(gene, stat = "Timing (peak, R)",   value = R,
  #                          is_variable = gene %in% sig_timing_1$gene)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(is_variable = factor(is_variable, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
                               labels = c("Not significant", "Significant (YPD.1)")))

# ── Per-panel n and Wilcoxon p-value, baked into facet labels ───────────────
panel_stats <- conc_long %>%
  group_by(stat) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sig    = sum(is_variable == "Significant (YPD.1)"),
    n_notsig = sum(is_variable == "Not significant"),
    p        = wilcox.test(value ~ is_variable)$p.value,
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s\nn = %d vs %d, p = %s",
                          stat, n_sig, n_notsig,
                          ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", signif(p, 2))))

conc_long <- conc_long %>%
  left_join(panel_stats %>% select(stat, label), by = "stat") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = panel_stats$label))

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_concordance <- ggplot(conc_long, aes(is_variable, value, fill = is_variable)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, trim = FALSE, colour = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.06, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.3, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Not significant" = "grey70",
                                "Significant (YPD.1)" = "firebrick"),
                     guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cross-replicate Spearman r\n(per-strain amplitude)",
       title = "Replicate concordance is higher for permutation-significant genes",
       subtitle = "YPD.1 amplitude significance vs. reproducibility with YPD.2") +
  pub_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

print(p_concordance)

dir.create("../results", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("../results/replicate_concordance_by_significance.png", p_concordance,
       width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
print(final_targets_wide, n = Inf)
```

# Pick strains. 

## How did I choose min_cells = 60; 

median strain has 202.5 cells and even the 1st quartile (107) sits well above 60 — so the threshold mostly just cuts off the tail: the ~15% of strains (roughly 11 out of your 74) sitting between the minimum (27) and 60 cells, which are genuinely the thinnest-covered strains where a per-gene estimate would be least trustworthy.
```{r, eval = FALSE}
summary(obs1$n_cells)
mean(obs1$n_cells >= 60)   # fraction of strains that clear the bar
```



First look at the distribution of perentage of gene expressed per strain. You want a gene to be highly expressed but what is the highly expressed ceiling for per strain needs to be know. 

Looks like for MRH1 it is only 60% and Can keep most strains if I keep a percentage of 30% -- same for TIP1 vs HHT2 is highly expressed so I can keep higher percentage expressed like 80%



```{r, eval = FALSE}
# moved up from below: used from here on (to_orf_local, name_lookup)
name_lookup <- gene_summary_1 %>% select(gene, name) %>% distinct()
to_orf_local <- function(x) {
  hit <- name_lookup$gene[match(x, name_lookup$name)]
  ifelse(is.na(hit), x, hit)
}
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# ── Detection-rate helper — pct of a strain's cells where the gene is nonzero ─
gene_detection_by_strain <- function(orf, raw_mat, meta) {
  if (!orf %in% rownames(raw_mat))
    return(tibble(strain = character(), pct_detected = numeric()))
  tibble(cell = colnames(raw_mat), count = as.numeric(raw_mat[orf, ])) %>%
    left_join(meta %>% select(cell, strain), by = "cell") %>%
    filter(!is.na(strain)) %>%
    group_by(strain) %>%
    summarise(pct_detected = mean(count > 0), .groups = "drop")
}

orf <- to_orf_local("YDR033W")

det <- gene_detection_by_strain(orf, raw_counts_mat, meta_slim) %>%
  left_join(tibble(strain = names(obs1$n_cells), n_cells = obs1$n_cells), by = "strain") %>%
  filter(n_cells >= 60)

cat("Detection-rate distribution among strains with n_cells >= 60:\n")
print(summary(det$pct_detected))

for (th in c(0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9)) {
  cat(sprintf("pct_detected > %.1f : %d / %d strains survive (%.0f%%)\n",
              th, sum(det$pct_detected > th), nrow(det),
              100 * mean(det$pct_detected > th)))
}
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
  filter(!flag_low_concordance) %>% arrange(desc(min_excess))

best_time_candidates <- timing_target_significant_in_both %>%
  filter(!flag_low_concordance) %>% arrange(desc(min_excess))

best_str_candidates  <- structure_target_significant_in_both %>%
  filter(!flag_low_concordance) %>% arrange(desc(min_excess))

target_genes <- unique(c(best_amp_candidates$gene, best_time_candidates$gene, best_str_candidates$gene))

cor_with_n <- function(M, ncells) {
  apply(M[target_genes, , drop = FALSE], 1, function(v) {
    ok <- !is.na(v)
    if (sum(ok) < 10) return(NA_real_)
    cor(v[ok], ncells[ok], method = "spearman")
  })
}

cat("Median |cor(value, n_cells)| across target genes:\n")
cat("  r2_adj :", round(median(abs(cor_with_n(obs1$r2_adj, obs1$n_cells)), na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("  amp1_db:", round(median(abs(cor_with_n(AMP1,        obs1$n_cells)), na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("  peak   :", round(median(abs(cor_with_n(obs1$peak,   obs1$n_cells)), na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
.print_bench <- function(d, bench) {
  bench_found <- intersect(bench, d$strain)
  if (length(bench_found) == 0) {
    cat("Benchmark strains: none of", paste(bench, collapse = ", "), "in eligible set\n")
  } else {
    cat("\nBenchmark strains:\n")
    print(d %>% filter(strain %in% bench_found) %>%
            select(strain, value, n_cells, pct_detected))
  }
}
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# ── Shared internals (not meant to be called directly) ─────────────────────
.build_strain_table <- function(gene_name, phenotype, replicate,
                                 min_cells = 60, min_pct_detected = 0.3) {
  orf  <- to_orf_local(gene_name)
  name <- name_lookup$name[match(orf, name_lookup$gene)]
  if (is.na(name)) name <- orf   # fall back to the ORF if no common name is on record

  obs_r  <- if (replicate == "ypd1") obs1 else obs2
  amp_r  <- if (replicate == "ypd1") AMP1 else AMP2
  raw_r  <- if (replicate == "ypd1") raw_counts_mat else raw_counts_mat_ypd2
  meta_r <- if (replicate == "ypd1") meta_slim      else meta_slim_ypd2
  M      <- switch(phenotype, amp = amp_r, peak = obs_r$peak, r2 = obs_r$r2_adj)

  det <- gene_detection_by_strain(orf, raw_r, meta_r)

  d <- tibble(strain = colnames(M), value = M[orf, ],
              n_cells = obs_r$n_cells[colnames(M)]) %>%
    left_join(det, by = "strain") %>%
    filter(!is.na(value), n_cells >= min_cells,
           !is.na(pct_detected), pct_detected >= min_pct_detected) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_cells))

  cat("\n===", name, "(", orf, ") -", phenotype, "-", replicate, "===\n")
  cat("Eligible strains (n_cells >=", min_cells,
      "& pct_detected >=", min_pct_detected, "):", nrow(d), "\n")
  print(summary(d$value))
  cat("Detection rate among eligible strains:\n"); print(summary(d$pct_detected))
  cat("cor(value, n_cells) within eligible set:",
      round(cor(d$value, d$n_cells, method = "spearman"), 3),
      "  <- if large, the trio may be picking on cell count\n")

  d
}
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
pick_trio_peak <- function(gene_name, replicate = c("ypd1", "ypd2"),
                            min_cells = 60, min_pct_detected = 0.3,
                            bench = c("AKM", "BCK", "BDP")) {
  replicate <- match.arg(replicate)
  d <- .build_strain_table(gene_name, "peak", replicate, min_cells, min_pct_detected)

  ctr <- circ_mean_rows(matrix(d$value, nrow = 1))
  d   <- d %>% mutate(dev = ((value - ctr + WRAP/2) %% WRAP) - WRAP/2)

  trio <- bind_rows(
    d %>% slice_max(dev, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% mutate(tier = "late"),
    d %>% slice_min(abs(dev), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% mutate(tier = "mid"),
    d %>% slice_min(dev, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% mutate(tier = "early"))

  attr(trio, "consensus_peak") <- ctr   # <- lets plot_trio_dynamics draw the reference line/arrows

  cat("Consensus peak for this gene:", round(ctr, 1), "min\n")
  print(trio %>% select(tier, strain, value, dev, n_cells, pct_detected))
  cat("Early-late spread:", round(diff(range(trio$dev)), 1), "min (circular, real)\n")

  .print_bench(d, bench)
  invisible(trio)
}
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
  .print_bench(d, bench)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
check_trio_overlap <- function(gene_name, replicate = "ypd1",
                                min_cells = 60, min_pct_detected = 0.3) {
  quiet <- function(expr) { capture.output(out <- expr); out }

  peak_trio <- quiet(pick_trio_peak(gene_name, replicate, min_cells, min_pct_detected))
  amp_trio  <- quiet(pick_trio_amp (gene_name, replicate, min_cells, min_pct_detected))
  r2_trio   <- quiet(pick_trio_r2  (gene_name, replicate, min_cells, min_pct_detected))

  all_picks <- bind_rows(
    peak_trio %>% mutate(phenotype = "peak"),
    amp_trio  %>% mutate(phenotype = "amp"),
    r2_trio   %>% mutate(phenotype = "r2")
  )

  overlap <- all_picks %>%
    group_by(strain) %>%
    summarise(n_phenotypes = n_distinct(phenotype),
              phenotypes = paste(sort(unique(phenotype)), collapse = ","),
              tiers = paste(tier, collapse = ","), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(n_phenotypes))

  cat("\n──────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat("Gene:", gene_name, "| replicate:", replicate, "\n")
  cat("──────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

  cat("\n[1] Per-phenotype trio picks (raw input — 3 strains x 3 phenotypes)\n")
  print(all_picks %>% select(phenotype, tier, strain, n_cells, pct_detected))

  cat("\n[2] >>> RESULT: cross-phenotype strain overlap <<<\n")
  print(overlap)

  invisible(list(all_picks = all_picks, overlap = overlap))
}
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
composite_trio <- function(gene_name, replicate = "ypd1",
                            min_cells = 60, min_pct_detected = 0.3) {
  orf   <- to_orf_local(gene_name)
  obs_r <- if (replicate == "ypd1") obs1 else obs2
  amp_r <- if (replicate == "ypd1") AMP1 else AMP2
  raw_r  <- if (replicate == "ypd1") raw_counts_mat else raw_counts_mat_ypd2
  meta_r <- if (replicate == "ypd1") meta_slim      else meta_slim_ypd2

  det <- gene_detection_by_strain(orf, raw_r, meta_r)

  d <- tibble(
    strain  = colnames(obs_r$r2_adj),
    n_cells = obs_r$n_cells[colnames(obs_r$r2_adj)],
    r2      = obs_r$r2_adj[orf, ],
    amp     = amp_r[orf, ],
    peak    = obs_r$peak[orf, ]
  ) %>%
    left_join(det, by = "strain") %>%
    filter(!is.na(r2), !is.na(amp), !is.na(peak),
           n_cells >= min_cells,
           !is.na(pct_detected), pct_detected >= min_pct_detected)

  ctr <- circ_mean_rows(matrix(d$peak, nrow = 1))
  d <- d %>% mutate(
    peak_dev = ((peak - ctr + WRAP/2) %% WRAP) - WRAP/2,
    rank_r2   = percent_rank(r2),
    rank_amp  = percent_rank(amp),
    rank_peak = percent_rank(abs(peak_dev)),
    composite = (rank_r2 + rank_amp + rank_peak) / 3
  ) %>% arrange(desc(composite))

  bind_rows(
    d %>% slice_max(composite, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% mutate(tier = "high_overall"),
    d %>% slice_min(abs(composite - median(composite)), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% mutate(tier = "mid_overall"),
    d %>% slice_min(composite, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% mutate(tier = "low_overall")
  ) %>% select(tier, strain, n_cells, pct_detected, r2, amp, peak, composite)
}

composite_trio("YBR067C")
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(MASS)

HARMONICS <- 2
GRID      <- seq(0, WRAP, length.out = 89)

harmonic_design <- function(t, K = HARMONICS, period = WRAP, depth = NULL) {
  X <- matrix(1, nrow = length(t), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, "intercept"))
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    X <- cbind(X, cos(2 * pi * k * t / period), sin(2 * pi * k * t / period))
    colnames(X)[(ncol(X) - 1):ncol(X)] <- paste0(c("cos", "sin"), k)
  }
  if (!is.null(depth)) X <- cbind(X, depth = depth)
  X
}

nb_input1 <- readRDS(file.path(ROOT1, "ypd1_nb_input.rds"))
nb_input2 <- readRDS(file.path(ROOT2, "ypd2_nb_input.rds"))

nb_harmonic <- function(gene, strain, nb_input, K = HARMONICS) {
  idx <- which(nb_input$gvec == strain)
  y <- as.numeric(nb_input$raw[gene, idx]); if (sum(y > 0) < 10) return(NULL)
  X  <- harmonic_design(nb_input$tvec[idx], K)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  df <- as.data.frame(X); df$y <- y; df$off <- log(nb_input$libsize[idx])
  m <- tryCatch(MASS::glm.nb(y ~ . - off + offset(off), data = df),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m)) return(NULL)
  b    <- coef(m)
  pred <- cbind(1, harmonic_design(GRID, K)[, -1, drop = FALSE]) %*% b
  tibble(gene = gene, strain = strain,
         log_amp = diff(range(pred)), peak = GRID[which.max(pred)], theta = m$theta)
}
```

# plotiing function
part 1. Phase boundary is important for figure
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# defines compute_phase_boundaries(); depends on WRAP/PHASE_LEVELS/PHASE_FILL
WRAP         <- 88
PHASE_LEVELS <- c('M-G1', 'G1', 'S', 'G2', 'M')
PHASE_FILL   <- c('M-G1'='#a8d5a2','G1'='#ffd6a5','S'='#ffadad',
                  'G2'='#bde0fe','M'='#ffc8dd')

compute_phase_boundaries <- function(meta, wrap = WRAP,
                                     phase_col = "CC", time_col = "pseudotime",
                                     levels = PHASE_LEVELS, fills = PHASE_FILL) {
  df <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[phase_col]]), !is.na(.data[[time_col]]))
  cmean <- df %>%
    group_by(phase = .data[[phase_col]]) %>%
    summarise(ang = atan2(mean(sin(2*pi*.data[[time_col]]/wrap)),
                          mean(cos(2*pi*.data[[time_col]]/wrap))), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(mu = (ang %% (2*pi)) * wrap / (2*pi)) %>%
    filter(phase %in% levels) %>% arrange(mu)
  P <- nrow(cmean); mu <- cmean$mu; ph <- cmean$phase
  fwd_mid <- function(a, b) { d <- (b - a) %% wrap; (a + d/2) %% wrap }
  bnd   <- vapply(seq_len(P), function(i) fwd_mid(mu[i], mu[(i %% P) + 1]), numeric(1))
  lower <- bnd[c(P, seq_len(P-1))]; upper <- bnd
  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(P)) {
    lo <- lower[i]; up <- upper[i]
    if (lo <= up) rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- data.frame(xmin=lo, xmax=up, phase=ph[i])
    else { rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- data.frame(xmin=lo, xmax=wrap, phase=ph[i])
           rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- data.frame(xmin=0,  xmax=up,   phase=ph[i]) }
  }
  pb <- bind_rows(rows); pb$fill <- fills[pb$phase]
  pb$phase <- factor(pb$phase, levels = levels)
  pl <- data.frame(x = mu, label = ph) %>%
    mutate(label = factor(label, levels = levels)) %>% arrange(label)
  list(boundaries = pb, labels = pl, means = setNames(round(mu, 2), ph))
}

pb_res           <- compute_phase_boundaries(meta_slim)
phase_boundaries <- pb_res$boundaries
phase_labels     <- pb_res$labels
print(pb_res$means)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
plot_gene_overview <- function(gene_name, raw_mat = raw_counts_mat, meta = meta_slim,
                                scale = c("log10", "raw"), save = FALSE, show = TRUE) {
  scale <- match.arg(scale)
  orf <- to_orf_local(gene_name)
  gene_row <- if (orf %in% rownames(raw_mat)) orf else gene_name
  if (!gene_row %in% rownames(raw_mat)) {
    cat("Gene", gene_name, "(", orf, ") not found in raw count matrix\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  gene_df <- data.frame(
    cell      = colnames(raw_mat),
    raw_count = as.numeric(raw_mat[gene_row, ])
  ) %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "cell") %>%
    filter(!is.na(pseudotime), !is.na(strain))

  y_of <- function(x) if (scale == "log10") mean(log10(x + 1), na.rm = TRUE) else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lab <- if (scale == "log10") "Mean log10(raw count + 1)" else "Mean raw count"

  global_sum <- gene_df %>% mutate(time_bin = round(pseudotime, 0)) %>%
    group_by(time_bin) %>% summarise(y = y_of(raw_count), .groups = "drop")
  strain_sum <- gene_df %>% mutate(time_bin = round(pseudotime, 0)) %>%
    group_by(time_bin, strain) %>% summarise(y = y_of(raw_count), .groups = "drop")

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = phase_boundaries,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = phase),
              alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(phase_boundaries$fill, phase_boundaries$phase)) +
    geom_text(data = phase_labels, aes(x = x, y = Inf, label = label),
              vjust = 2, size = PUB_LABEL, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_smooth(data = strain_sum, aes(x = time_bin, y = y, group = strain),
                method = "loess", span = 0.5, se = FALSE,
                color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_smooth(data = global_sum, aes(x = time_bin, y = y, group = 1),
                method = "loess", span = 0.3, se = FALSE,
                color = "black", linewidth = 1.4) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 88), breaks = seq(0, 88, 12)) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    labs(x = "Time in cell cycle (min)", y = y_lab,
         title = paste0(gene_name, " — overall dynamics (", scale, ")"),
         subtitle = "Black = global average across all strains | grey = individual strains") +
    theme_auditorium()

  if (save) ggsave(paste0("../results/", gene_name, "_overview_", scale, ".png"),
                    p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
  if (show) print(p)
  invisible(p)
}
```

# this is trio dynamics

```{r, eval = FALSE}
plot_trio_dynamics <- function(
    gene_name,
    trio,
    raw_mat  = raw_counts_mat,
    meta     = meta_slim,
    scale    = c("log10", "raw"),
    save     = FALSE,
    show     = TRUE,
    label    = NULL
) {
  scale <- match.arg(scale)

  orf <- to_orf_local(gene_name)
  gene_row <- if (orf %in% rownames(raw_mat)) orf else gene_name
  if (!gene_row %in% rownames(raw_mat)) {
    cat("Gene", gene_name, "(", orf, ") not found in raw count matrix\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  gene_df <- data.frame(
    cell      = colnames(raw_mat),
    raw_count = as.numeric(raw_mat[gene_row, ])
  ) %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "cell") %>%
    filter(!is.na(pseudotime), !is.na(strain))

  y_of <- function(x) if (scale == "log10") mean(log10(x + 1), na.rm = TRUE) else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lab <- if (scale == "log10") "Mean log10(raw count + 1)" else "Mean raw count"

  global_sum <- gene_df %>%
    mutate(time_bin = round(pseudotime, 0)) %>%
    group_by(time_bin) %>% summarise(y = y_of(raw_count), .groups = "drop")

  trio_sum <- gene_df %>%
    filter(strain %in% trio$strain) %>%
    mutate(time_bin = round(pseudotime, 0)) %>%
    left_join(trio %>% select(strain, tier), by = "strain") %>%
    group_by(time_bin, strain, tier) %>% summarise(y = y_of(raw_count), .groups = "drop")

  label_pos <- trio_sum %>%
    group_by(strain, tier) %>%
    slice_max(time_bin, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(strain, " (", tier, ")"))

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = phase_boundaries,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = phase),
              alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(phase_boundaries$fill, phase_boundaries$phase)) +
    geom_text(data = phase_labels, aes(x = x, y = Inf, label = label),
              vjust = 2, size = PUB_LABEL, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE) +

    geom_smooth(data = trio_sum,
                aes(x = time_bin, y = y, group = strain, color = tier),
                method = "loess", span = 0.5, se = FALSE, linewidth = 2.5) +

    geom_smooth(data = global_sum,
                aes(x = time_bin, y = y, group = 1),
                method = "loess", span = 0.3, se = FALSE,
                color = "black", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +

    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = label_pos,
      aes(x = time_bin, y = y, label = label, color = tier),
      size = PUB_LABEL, fontface = "bold", nudge_x = 3, direction = "y", hjust = 0,
      segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.4, segment.linetype = "dotted",
      fill = "white", label.size = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE, min.segment.length = 0
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(name = "Trio tier", values = tier_palette) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 108), breaks = seq(0, 88, 12)) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    labs(x = "Time in cell cycle (min)", y = y_lab,
         title = paste0(gene_name, " — validation trio dynamics (", scale, ")"),
         subtitle = "Bold = chosen trio | dashed black = global average") +
    theme_auditorium()

  # ── peak-time arrows + consensus line, only for pick_trio_peak() output ──
  consensus_peak <- attr(trio, "consensus_peak")
  if (!is.null(consensus_peak)) {
    y_range <- range(c(global_sum$y, trio_sum$y), na.rm = TRUE)
    y_pad   <- diff(y_range) * 0.12
    y_top   <- y_range[2] + y_pad
    y_base  <- y_range[2] + y_pad * 0.25

    peak_marks <- trio %>%
      transmute(tier, strain, value,
                label = paste0(strain, "\n", round(value, 1), " min"))

    p <- p +
      geom_vline(xintercept = consensus_peak, linetype = "dashed",
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
      annotate("text", x = consensus_peak, y = y_top, label = "consensus",
               vjust = -0.3, size = PUB_LABEL, fontface = "italic", color = "grey30") +
      geom_segment(data = peak_marks,
                   aes(x = value, xend = value, y = y_top, yend = y_base, color = tier),
                   arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
                   linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_text(data = peak_marks,
                aes(x = value, y = y_top, label = label, color = tier),
                vjust = -0.3, size = PUB_LABEL, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25)))
  }

  if (save) ggsave(paste0("../results/", gene_name, "_trio_dynamics_",
                          if (!is.null(label)) paste0(label, "_"), scale, ".png"),
                    p, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
  if (show) print(p)
  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(gridExtra)

plot_gene_full_panel <- function(gene_name, replicate = "ypd1",
                                  min_cells = 60, min_pct_detected = 0.3,
                                  save = TRUE) {
  p_overview <- plot_gene_overview(gene_name, show = FALSE)

  trio_amp  <- pick_trio_amp (gene_name, replicate, min_cells, min_pct_detected)
  trio_peak <- pick_trio_peak(gene_name, replicate, min_cells, min_pct_detected)
  trio_r2   <- pick_trio_r2  (gene_name, replicate, min_cells, min_pct_detected)
  trio_comp <- composite_trio(gene_name, replicate, min_cells, min_pct_detected)

  p_amp  <- plot_trio_dynamics(gene_name, trio_amp,  show = FALSE) + labs(title = "Amplitude trio")
  p_peak <- plot_trio_dynamics(gene_name, trio_peak, show = FALSE) + labs(title = "Timing trio")
  p_r2   <- plot_trio_dynamics(gene_name, trio_r2,   show = FALSE) + labs(title = "Structure (R2) trio")
  p_comp <- plot_trio_dynamics(gene_name, trio_comp, show = FALSE) + labs(title = "Composite trio")

  combined <- arrangeGrob(
    p_overview, p_amp, p_peak, p_r2, p_comp,
    layout_matrix = rbind(c(1, 1, 1),    # overview spans all 3 columns
                           c(2, 3, 4),    # amp | peak | r2, one per column
                           c(5, 5, 5)),   # composite spans all 3 columns
    top = paste0(gene_name, " — full validation panel")
  )

  # save first — independent of the Plots pane size
  if (save) {
    out_file <- paste0("../results/", gene_name, "_full_panel.png")
    ggsave(out_file, combined, width = 20, height = 18, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
    cat("Saved:", out_file, "\n")
  }

  # best-effort inline preview
  tryCatch(
    grid::grid.draw(combined),
    error = function(e) cat("Inline preview skipped (Plots pane too small) — open the saved PNG instead.\n")
  )

  invisible(combined)
}
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
compare_strain_metrics <- function(gene_name, replicate = "ypd1",
                                    min_cells = 60, min_pct_detected = 0.3,
                                    top_n = 15) {
  orf <- to_orf_local(gene_name)

  obs_r  <- if (replicate == "ypd1") obs1 else obs2
  amp_r  <- if (replicate == "ypd1") AMP1 else AMP2
  raw_r  <- if (replicate == "ypd1") raw_counts_mat else raw_counts_mat_ypd2
  meta_r <- if (replicate == "ypd1") meta_slim      else meta_slim_ypd2

  if (!orf %in% rownames(raw_r)) {
    cat("Gene", gene_name, "(", orf, ") not found in raw count matrix\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # overall per-strain mean expression — all cells, not time-binned
  expr_by_strain <- tibble(
    cell      = colnames(raw_r),
    raw_count = as.numeric(raw_r[orf, ])
  ) %>%
    left_join(meta_r %>% select(cell, strain), by = "cell") %>%
    filter(!is.na(strain)) %>%
    group_by(strain) %>%
    summarise(mean_raw   = mean(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_log10 = mean(log10(raw_count + 1), na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")

  det <- gene_detection_by_strain(orf, raw_r, meta_r)

  out <- expr_by_strain %>%
    left_join(det, by = "strain") %>%
    mutate(
      n_cells  = obs_r$n_cells[strain],
      r2       = obs_r$r2_adj[orf, strain],
      amp      = amp_r[orf, strain],
      peak     = obs_r$peak[orf, strain],
      eligible = !is.na(n_cells) & n_cells >= min_cells &
                 !is.na(pct_detected) & pct_detected >= min_pct_detected
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_log10))

  cat("\n===", gene_name, "(", orf, ") — mean expression vs. harmonic-fit phenotypes ===\n")
  cat("Eligibility requires n_cells >=", min_cells, "and pct_detected >=", min_pct_detected, "\n\n")
  print(out %>% select(strain, mean_log10, mean_raw, pct_detected, n_cells,
                        eligible, r2, amp, peak), n = top_n)

  invisible(out)
}

compare_strain_metrics("YBR067C")
```

# 12. Strain-level reproducibility (paper: reproducibility paragraph)

Everything in the paper's reproducibility paragraph, its supplementary table and
the two supplementary replicate figures comes from this section.

§11's `circ_conc()` asks whether each strain's peak *time* is the same in both
replicates. For a gene where every strain peaks at about the same time (the
histones, ~36 min) that is high even if the early/late strains differ, so it does
not test whether strain *differences* reproduce. Here timing is instead the
Spearman correlation, across shared strains, of each strain's signed deviation
from the gene's consensus peak. Amplitude is the same Spearman correlation as
§11's `concordance()`, now with a p-value and FDR per gene.

- Genes need >= `MIN_STRAINS` shared strains with a value in both replicates.
- FDR (BH) is computed within the genes significant in both replicates for that
  phenotype, the set the text reports on.

```{r repro_table}
MIN_STRAINS <- 20

peak_dev <- function(v) {          # signed minutes from the circular mean peak
  ctr <- circ_mean_rows(matrix(v, nrow = 1))
  ((v - ctr + WRAP / 2) %% WRAP) - WRAP / 2
}

rep_cor <- function(M1, M2, g, timing = FALSE) {
  strains <- intersect(colnames(M1), colnames(M2))
  if (!g %in% rownames(M1) || !g %in% rownames(M2))
    return(tibble(rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = 0L))
  x <- M1[g, strains]; y <- M2[g, strains]; ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  if (sum(ok) < MIN_STRAINS) return(tibble(rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = sum(ok)))
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  if (timing) { x <- peak_dev(x); y <- peak_dev(y) }   # deviation over shared strains
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  tibble(rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = sum(ok))
}

bh_within <- function(p, in_set) {
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(p)); k <- in_set & !is.na(p)
  out[k] <- p.adjust(p[k], method = "BH"); out
}

gene_names <- bind_rows(gene_summary_1 %>% select(gene, name),
                        gene_summary_2 %>% select(gene, name)) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
to_name <- function(x) { n <- gene_names$name[match(x, gene_names$gene)]; ifelse(is.na(n), x, n) }
to_orf  <- function(x) { g <- gene_names$gene[match(x, gene_names$name)]; ifelse(is.na(g), x, g) }

A1 <- sig_amplitude_1$gene; A2 <- sig_amplitude_2$gene
T1 <- sig_timing_1$gene;    T2 <- sig_timing_2$gene

repro <- tibble(gene = sort(union(union(A1, A2), union(T1, T2)))) %>%
  mutate(name = to_name(gene),
         amp_sig_ypd1 = gene %in% A1, amp_sig_ypd2 = gene %in% A2,
         timing_sig_ypd1 = gene %in% T1, timing_sig_ypd2 = gene %in% T2,
         amp_reproduced = amp_sig_ypd1 & amp_sig_ypd2,
         timing_reproduced = timing_sig_ypd1 & timing_sig_ypd2,
         amp = map(gene, ~ rep_cor(AMP1, AMP2, .x)),
         tim = map(gene, ~ rep_cor(obs1$peak, obs2$peak, .x, timing = TRUE))) %>%
  unnest_wider(amp, names_sep = "_") %>% unnest_wider(tim, names_sep = "_") %>%
  dplyr::rename(amp_n_strains = amp_n, timing_rho = tim_rho, timing_p = tim_p,
                timing_n_strains = tim_n) %>%
  mutate(amp_fdr    = bh_within(amp_p,    amp_reproduced),
         timing_fdr = bh_within(timing_p, timing_reproduced)) %>%
  arrange(desc(amp_reproduced), desc(amp_rho)) %>%
  select(name, gene, amp_sig_ypd1, amp_sig_ypd2, amp_reproduced,
         amp_rho, amp_p, amp_fdr, amp_n_strains,
         timing_sig_ypd1, timing_sig_ypd2, timing_reproduced,
         timing_rho, timing_p, timing_fdr, timing_n_strains)

write.csv(repro %>% mutate(across(c(amp_rho, timing_rho), ~ round(.x, 3))),
          file.path(ROOT1, "paper_tables/SuppTable_replicate_reproducibility.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Shared strains:", length(intersect(colnames(AMP1), colnames(AMP2))), "\n")
cat("Amplitude: significant YPD.1", length(A1), "| YPD.2", length(A2),
    "| both", sum(repro$amp_reproduced), "| of those, strain-level FDR < 0.05:",
    sum(repro$amp_fdr < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Timing:    significant YPD.1", length(T1), "| YPD.2", length(T2),
    "| both", sum(repro$timing_reproduced), "| testable", sum(!is.na(repro$timing_fdr)),
    "| strain-level FDR < 0.05:", sum(repro$timing_fdr < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")
repro %>% filter(name %in% c("MRH1", "TIP1", "CTS1", "HHF1", "HHF2", "HHT2", "HTB2")) %>%
  select(name, amp_reproduced, amp_rho, amp_fdr, timing_reproduced, timing_rho, timing_fdr) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```

## 12.1 Supplementary replicate figures

YPD.1 and YPD.2 side by side, per-strain curves on top and per-strain peak time
vs amplitude underneath, drawn exactly as Figure 5 (`cc_panel()` and
`strain_scatter()` below are copied from `Fig5.cell-cycle-harmonic.Rmd` §9 —
keep them in sync). The same four strains are coloured in both replicates: for
amplitude the two highest- and two lowest-amplitude strains in YPD.1, for timing
the two earliest- and two latest-peaking, among strains with >= `HL_MIN_CELLS`
cells in both.

Normalised expression is rebuilt from the saved raw Spellman counts
(`*_nb_input.rds`) the same way Seurat's LogNormalize does,
log1p(count / nCount_RNA × 1e4); the check below confirms it matches the YPD.1
Seurat object used in the main analysis.

```{r repro_plot_functions}
CC_LEVELS  <- c('M-G1', 'G1', 'S', 'G2', 'M')
PHASE_FILL <- c('M-G1'='#a8d5a2','G1'='#ffd6a5','S'='#ffadad',
                'G2'='#bde0fe','M'='#ffc8dd')
HARMONICS  <- 2
GRID       <- seq(0, WRAP, length.out = 89)

harmonic_design <- function(t, K = HARMONICS, period = WRAP, depth = NULL) {
  X <- matrix(1, nrow = length(t), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, "intercept"))
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    X <- cbind(X, cos(2 * pi * k * t / period), sin(2 * pi * k * t / period))
    colnames(X)[(ncol(X) - 1):ncol(X)] <- paste0(c("cos", "sin"), k)
  }
  if (!is.null(depth)) X <- cbind(X, depth = depth)
  X
}

# The anchors given to calculate_times (M-G1 7, G1 22.5, S 39.5, G2 56.5, M 77.5)
# are the times at each phase's CENTROID, not phase starts. Band edges are the
# midpoints between consecutive centroids (M -> M-G1 wraps: (77.5 + 7 + 88) / 2).
PHASE_CENTROIDS <- c('M-G1' = 7, 'G1' = 22.5, 'S' = 39.5, 'G2' = 56.5, 'M' = 77.5)
.edges <- (PHASE_CENTROIDS + c(PHASE_CENTROIDS[-1], PHASE_CENTROIDS[1] + WRAP)) / 2
PHASE_BOUNDS <- tibble(
  xmin  = c(0,           .edges[1:4],  .edges[5]),
  xmax  = c(.edges[1:4], .edges[5],    WRAP),
  phase = factor(c('M-G1','G1','S','G2','M','M-G1'), levels = CC_LEVELS)
)

harmonic_curve <- function(gene, strain = NULL, K = HARMONICS) {
  idx <- if (is.null(strain)) seq_along(tvec) else which(gvec == strain)
  y <- Y_cc[idx, gene]
  if (length(idx) < 2 * K + 4) return(NULL)
  if (sd(y) == 0)
    return(tibble(time = GRID, y = mean(y), strain = strain %||% "global", detected = FALSE))
  X <- harmonic_design(tvec[idx], K)
  b <- qr.coef(qr(X), y); b[is.na(b)] <- 0
  tibble(time = GRID, y = as.numeric(harmonic_design(GRID, K) %*% b),
         strain = strain %||% "global", detected = TRUE)
}

HIGHLIGHT_COLS <- c("firebrick", "steelblue", "darkorange", "purple4")

# hl_labels (added here, not in the main Rmd): optional legend labels for the
# highlighted strains, named by strain
cc_panel <- function(genes, per_strain = TRUE, ncol = 3, title = NULL, highlight = NULL,
                     hl_labels = NULL) {
  orfs <- to_orf(genes)
  orfs <- orfs[orfs %in% colnames(Y_cc)]
  if (length(orfs) == 0) { message("cc_panel: no genes to plot"); return(invisible(NULL)) }

  global <- map_dfr(orfs, function(g) {
    hc <- harmonic_curve(g); if (is.null(hc)) return(NULL); mutate(hc, gene = g)
  })
  strains <- names(n_by_strain)
  per <- if (per_strain)
    map_dfr(orfs, function(g)
      map_dfr(strains, function(s) {
        hc <- harmonic_curve(g, s); if (is.null(hc)) return(NULL); mutate(hc, gene = g)
      })) else NULL
  binned <- tibble(gene = rep(orfs, each = length(tvec)),
                   t = rep(round(tvec) %% WRAP, times = length(orfs)),
                   y = as.vector(Y_cc[, orfs])) %>%
    group_by(gene, t) %>% summarise(y = mean(y), .groups = "drop")

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = PHASE_BOUNDS,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = phase),
              alpha = 0.20, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = filter(PHASE_BOUNDS, xmax - xmin > 5),   # skip the 86.25–88 wrap sliver
              aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = Inf, label = phase),
              vjust = 1.4, size = PUB_LABEL, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey25",
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PHASE_FILL, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.14)))
  if (per_strain)
    p <- p + geom_line(data = per %>% mutate(label = to_name(gene)),
                       aes(time, y, group = strain, linetype = detected),
                       colour = "grey45", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.3) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "solid", `FALSE` = "22"), guide = "none")
  if (per_strain && length(highlight))
    p <- p + geom_line(data = per %>% filter(strain %in% highlight) %>%
                         mutate(label = to_name(gene)),
                       aes(time, y, group = strain, colour = strain), linewidth = 0.9) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(HIGHLIGHT_COLS[seq_along(highlight)], highlight),
                          breaks = highlight,
                          labels = if (is.null(hl_labels)) highlight else unname(hl_labels[highlight]),
                          name = "Strain")
  p +
    geom_point(data = binned %>% mutate(label = to_name(gene)),
               aes(t, y), size = 1, alpha = 0.6, colour = "grey20") +
    geom_line(data = global %>% mutate(label = to_name(gene)),
              aes(time, y), colour = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, WRAP, 11)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, WRAP)) +
    facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    labs(x = "Time in cell cycle (min)", y = "Normalized expression", title = title) +
    pub_theme + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# hl_labels (added here, not in the main Rmd): optional point labels for the
# highlighted strains, named by strain
strain_scatter <- function(gene_ids, title, subtitle = NULL, highlight = NULL, ncol = 3,
                           hl_labels = NULL) {
  df <- map_dfr(gene_ids, ~ tibble(gene = .x, strain = colnames(AMP),
                                   amp = AMP[.x, ], peak = obs$peak[.x, ],
                                   n_cells = n_by_strain,
                                   poor_cov = colnames(AMP) %in% POOR_COVERAGE)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(amp)) %>%
    mutate(name = to_name(gene),
           hl_label = if (is.null(hl_labels)) strain else unname(hl_labels[strain]))
  hl_layers <- if (length(highlight)) list(
    geom_point(data = filter(df, strain %in% highlight),
               aes(fill = strain), shape = 21, size = 3.5, colour = "black"),
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = filter(df, strain %in% highlight),
                             aes(label = hl_label), size = PUB_LABEL,
                             min.segment.length = 0),
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(HIGHLIGHT_COLS[seq_along(highlight)], highlight))
  )
  ggplot(df, aes(peak, amp)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n_cells, colour = poor_cov), alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "black", `TRUE` = "firebrick"),
                        guide = "none") +
    hl_layers +
    facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, WRAP, 11)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, WRAP)) +
    labs(x = "Peak time (min)", y = "Amplitude (bias-corrected)",
         title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    pub_theme + theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```

```{r repro_figures}
HL_MIN_CELLS <- 50   # highlight only strains with >= 50 cells in both replicates

# per-replicate data, set as globals for cc_panel() / strain_scatter()
load_rep <- function(root, tag, obs) {
  nb  <- readRDS(file.path(root, paste0(tag, "_nb_input.rds")))
  Y   <- t(as.matrix(log1p(nb$raw %*% Matrix::Diagonal(x = 1e4 / nb$libsize))))
  rownames(Y) <- colnames(nb$raw)
  strains <- colnames(obs$amp1_db)
  list(Y_cc = Y, tvec = nb$tvec, gvec = nb$gvec, libsize = nb$libsize,
       n_by_strain = setNames(as.integer(table(nb$gvec)[strains]), strains),
       AMP = obs$amp1_db, obs = obs,
       POOR_COVERAGE = readRDS(file.path(root, paste0(tag, "_poor_coverage.rds"))))
}
reps <- list("YPD.1" = load_rep(ROOT1, "ypd1", obs1),
             "YPD.2" = load_rep(ROOT2, "ypd2", obs2))
use_rep <- function(name) list2env(reps[[name]], envir = globalenv())

# check: rebuilt YPD.1 expression matches the Seurat object the analysis used
Na_va_norm <- readRDS("../results/ypd1_Na_va_with_cc_time_normalized.rds")
chk <- intersect(colnames(reps$YPD.1$Y_cc), c("YBR009C", "YLR286C", "YCR089W"))
cat("Max |rebuilt - Seurat| normalised expression:",
    signif(max(abs(t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(Na_va_norm, layer = "data")[chk, rownames(reps$YPD.1$Y_cc)])) -
                   reps$YPD.1$Y_cc[, chk])), 3), "\n")
rm(Na_va_norm)

# highlighted strains: amplitude — the two highest in YPD.1;
# timing — the two earliest + two latest in YPD.1
n1 <- reps$YPD.1$n_by_strain; n2 <- reps$YPD.2$n_by_strain
hl_pool <- intersect(names(n1)[n1 >= HL_MIN_CELLS], names(n2)[n2 >= HL_MIN_CELLS])
pick_extremes <- function(v) { v <- sort(v[!is.na(v)]); c(head(names(v), 2), tail(names(v), 2)) }
hl_amp    <- function(g) {
  v <- sort(AMP1[g, intersect(hl_pool, colnames(AMP1))], decreasing = TRUE)
  head(names(v), 2)
}
# timing: strains >= TIMING_SHIFT min early (or late) of the consensus in BOTH replicates
TIMING_SHIFT <- 3
hl_timing <- function(g) {
  s  <- intersect(hl_pool, intersect(names(which(!is.na(obs1$peak[g, ]))),
                                     names(which(!is.na(obs2$peak[g, ])))))
  d1 <- peak_dev(obs1$peak[g, s]); d2 <- peak_dev(obs2$peak[g, s])
  s[(d1 <= -TIMING_SHIFT & d2 <= -TIMING_SHIFT) | (d1 >= TIMING_SHIFT & d2 >= TIMING_SHIFT)]
}

# one gene: YPD.1 | YPD.2 columns, curves over scatter, one shared strain legend.
# Highlighted strains carry their cell counts: both replicates in the shared
# legend, that replicate's count on the scatter labels.
rep_block <- function(gene_name, highlight) {
  orf <- to_orf(gene_name)
  legend_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (YPD.1 %d, YPD.2 %d cells)", highlight,
                                 n1[highlight], n2[highlight]), highlight)
  cols <- lapply(names(reps), function(r) {
    use_rep(r)
    point_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (%d cells)", highlight, n_by_strain[highlight]), highlight)
    list(top = cc_panel(orf, ncol = 1, highlight = highlight, hl_labels = legend_lab) +
           labs(title = r, x = "Time in cell cycle (min)"),
         bottom = strain_scatter(orf, title = NULL, highlight = highlight, ncol = 1,
                                 hl_labels = point_lab) +
           guides(size = "none", fill = "none", colour = "none"))
  })
  patchwork::wrap_plots(cols[[1]]$top, cols[[2]]$top,
                        cols[[1]]$bottom, cols[[2]]$bottom, ncol = 2) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

dir.create(file.path(ROOT1, "paper_panels"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

hl_mrh1 <- hl_amp(to_orf("MRH1")); hl_tip1 <- hl_amp(to_orf("TIP1"))
cat("Highlighted strains — MRH1:", hl_mrh1, "| TIP1:", hl_tip1, "\n")
p_rep_amp <- patchwork::wrap_plots(rep_block("MRH1", hl_mrh1), rep_block("TIP1", hl_tip1), ncol = 2)
print(p_rep_amp)
ggsave(file.path(ROOT1, "paper_panels/Supp_replicate_amplitude_MRH1_TIP1.png"), p_rep_amp,
       width = 20, height = 10, dpi = 300)

hl_cts1 <- hl_timing(to_orf("CTS1"))
cat("Highlighted strains — CTS1:", hl_cts1, "\n")
p_rep_tim <- rep_block("CTS1", hl_cts1)
print(p_rep_tim)
ggsave(file.path(ROOT1, "paper_panels/Supp_replicate_timing_CTS1.png"), p_rep_tim,
       width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

## 12.2 Values of the highlighted strains, and CTS1 strains early or late in both

Amplitude rank is among strains with a value in both replicates (1 = highest).
For the highlighted MRH1 and TIP1 strains, each replicate's curve is refit exactly as in
the analysis (two harmonics + within-strain centred log-depth, read at depth 0)
and its two highest local maxima are reported, so a switch between two
peaks shows up directly. Peak deviation is minutes from that replicate's
consensus CTS1 peak (negative = earlier).

```{r repro_highlighted_strains}
# two highest local maxima of a strain's fitted curve (circular, 1-min grid)
humps <- function(rep_name, g, s) {
  r <- reps[[rep_name]]; i <- which(r$gvec == s)
  dep <- log1p(r$libsize[i]); dep <- dep - mean(dep)
  b  <- qr.coef(qr(harmonic_design(r$tvec[i], depth = dep)), r$Y_cc[i, g]); b[is.na(b)] <- 0
  cv <- as.numeric(harmonic_design(GRID, depth = rep(0, length(GRID))) %*% b)
  v  <- cv[-length(cv)]                                    # drop 88 (= 0)
  is_max <- v > c(v[length(v)], v[-length(v)]) & v >= c(v[-1], v[1])
  m <- order(v[is_max], decreasing = TRUE)[1:2]
  tibble(peak_main = GRID[which(is_max)[m[1]]], height_main = round(v[is_max][m[1]], 2),
         peak_second = GRID[which(is_max)[m[2]]], height_second = round(v[is_max][m[2]], 2))
}

amp_rank_tbl <- function(gene_name, strains) {
  g <- to_orf(gene_name)
  a1 <- AMP1[g, ]; a2 <- AMP2[g, ]
  s  <- intersect(names(a1)[!is.na(a1)], names(a2)[!is.na(a2)])
  r1 <- rank(-a1[s], ties.method = "min"); r2 <- rank(-a2[s], ties.method = "min")
  map_dfr(strains, function(st)
    bind_cols(
      tibble(gene = gene_name, strain = st, n_ranked = length(s),
             ypd1_amp = round(a1[st], 2), ypd1_rank = r1[st], ypd1_peak = obs1$peak[g, st],
             ypd2_amp = round(a2[st], 2), ypd2_rank = r2[st], ypd2_peak = obs2$peak[g, st]),
      humps("YPD.1", g, st) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("ypd1_", .x)),
      humps("YPD.2", g, st) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("ypd2_", .x))))
}
highlight_amp_tbl <- bind_rows(amp_rank_tbl("MRH1", hl_mrh1), amp_rank_tbl("TIP1", hl_tip1))
stopifnot(all(highlight_amp_tbl$ypd1_peak == highlight_amp_tbl$ypd1_peak_main),
          all(highlight_amp_tbl$ypd2_peak == highlight_amp_tbl$ypd2_peak_main))  # refit = analysis
print(highlight_amp_tbl, width = Inf)

cts1 <- to_orf("CTS1")
s_cts1 <- intersect(names(which(!is.na(obs1$peak[cts1, ]))), names(which(!is.na(obs2$peak[cts1, ]))))
cts1_tbl <- tibble(gene = "CTS1", strain = s_cts1,
                   ypd1_peak = obs1$peak[cts1, s_cts1], ypd1_dev = round(peak_dev(obs1$peak[cts1, s_cts1]), 1),
                   ypd2_peak = obs2$peak[cts1, s_cts1], ypd2_dev = round(peak_dev(obs2$peak[cts1, s_cts1]), 1),
                   ypd1_n_cells = reps$YPD.1$n_by_strain[s_cts1],
                   ypd2_n_cells = reps$YPD.2$n_by_strain[s_cts1]) %>%
  mutate(pattern = case_when(ypd1_dev <= -TIMING_SHIFT & ypd2_dev <= -TIMING_SHIFT ~ "early in both",
                             ypd1_dev >=  TIMING_SHIFT & ypd2_dev >=  TIMING_SHIFT ~ "late in both",
                             abs(ypd1_dev) >= TIMING_SHIFT & abs(ypd2_dev) >= TIMING_SHIFT ~ "opposite",
                             TRUE ~ ""),
         highlighted = strain %in% hl_cts1)
cat("CTS1 consensus peak — YPD.1:", round(circ_mean_rows(matrix(obs1$peak[cts1, s_cts1], 1)), 1),
    "min | YPD.2:", round(circ_mean_rows(matrix(obs2$peak[cts1, s_cts1], 1)), 1), "min\n")
print(cts1_tbl %>% filter(pattern != "" | highlighted) %>% arrange(pattern, ypd1_dev), n = Inf)

write.csv(highlight_amp_tbl, file.path(ROOT1, "paper_tables/SuppTable_replicate_highlighted_amplitude.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cts1_tbl, file.path(ROOT1, "paper_tables/SuppTable_replicate_CTS1_peak_by_strain.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## 12.3 Peak width and timing reproducibility

Peak width is the number of minutes per cycle that a gene's curve, fitted to all
YPD.1 cells (two harmonics + centred log-depth, evaluated at mean depth on a
0.1-minute grid), spends above half its height (midpoint of minimum and maximum).
Smaller = sharper peak. Tested across the genes whose timing was significant in
both replicates and could be correlated between them.

```{r repro_peak_width}
nb1   <- readRDS(file.path(ROOT1, "ypd1_nb_input.rds"))
fine  <- seq(0, WRAP, by = 0.1)
dep   <- log1p(nb1$libsize); dep <- dep - mean(dep)
qr_p  <- qr(harmonic_design(nb1$tvec, depth = dep))
G_p   <- harmonic_design(fine, depth = rep(0, length(fine)))

peak_width <- function(g) {
  cv <- as.numeric(G_p %*% qr.coef(qr_p, reps$YPD.1$Y_cc[, g]))
  tibble(gene = g, width_min = round(mean(cv > (max(cv) + min(cv)) / 2) * WRAP, 1),
         pooled_peak_min = fine[which.max(cv)])
}
width_tbl <- repro %>%
  filter(timing_reproduced | name %in% c("HHF1", "HHF2", "HHT2", "HTB2", "MRH1", "TIP1")) %>%
  filter(gene %in% colnames(reps$YPD.1$Y_cc)) %>%
  select(name, gene, timing_reproduced, timing_rho, timing_fdr) %>%
  left_join(map_dfr(.$gene, peak_width), by = "gene") %>%
  arrange(width_min)
print(width_tbl, n = Inf)

wt <- width_tbl %>% filter(timing_reproduced, !is.na(timing_rho))
ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(wt$width_min, wt$timing_rho, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
cat("\nPeak width vs timing reproducibility (n =", nrow(wt), "genes): Spearman rho =",
    round(ct$estimate, 2), ", p =", signif(ct$p.value, 2), "\n")

write.csv(width_tbl, file.path(ROOT1, "paper_tables/SuppTable_timing_peak_width.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
